book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 2 Tuesdays with Morrie 相约星期二
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修四 Unit 2 词表(p117 真词)+ 本单元课文主题词(《相约星期二》/人生课题/智慧);IPA 标准词典英音;例句原创、含目标词、围绕本单元主题、不为凑而别扭;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Mitch was reunited with his favourite professor after many years.
words.example_cn: 多年之后,米奇与他最喜爱的教授重聚了。

words.example_en: Morrie was slowly weakened by a severe illness.
words.example_cn: 莫里被一场重病一点点拖垮了身体。

words.example_en: Despite his illness, Morrie stayed cheerful and full of hope.
words.example_cn: 尽管身患疾病,莫里仍然乐观、满怀希望。

words.example_en: He was suffering from a severe illness that could not be cured.
words.example_cn: 他患上了无法治愈的严重疾病。

words.example_en: Morrie had been a much-loved college professor for many years.
words.example_cn: 莫里多年来一直是一位深受爱戴的大学教授。

words.example_en: Before they met again, Mitch worked as a busy sports journalist.
words.example_cn: 再次相见之前,米奇是一名忙碌的体育记者。

words.example_en: The book is about dying, but it is not pessimistic at all.
words.example_cn: 这本书写的是死亡,但一点也不悲观。

words.example_en: As Morrie anticipated his own death, he saw the world through new eyes.
words.example_cn: 当莫里预料到自己的死亡时,他用全新的眼光看世界。

words.example_en: Morrie warned us not to value material possessions too much.
words.example_cn: 莫里告诫我们不要太看重物质财产。

words.example_en: Looking different from others does not make a person abnormal.
words.example_cn: 与别人长得不同并不会让一个人变得不正常。

words.example_en: The book has gained widespread recognition around the world.
words.example_cn: 这本书已在世界范围内获得广泛认可。

words.example_en: Despite its recognition, some readers doubted the book at first.
words.example_cn: 尽管这本书受到认可,有些读者起初却心存怀疑。

words.example_en: Each lesson is summed up in a short, memorable phrase.
words.example_cn: 每条道理都被浓缩成一句简短而难忘的警句。

words.example_en: It is easier to succeed if you cooperate with someone else.
words.example_cn: 如果你与他人合作,就更容易成功。

words.example_en: University fees were no barrier to the determined grandmother.
words.example_cn: 大学学费对这位有决心的老奶奶来说不是障碍。

words.example_en: In the play, the Happiness of Pure Air is almost invisible.
words.example_cn: 在剧中,纯净空气之幸福几乎是看不见的。

words.example_en: Happiness is not found in luxury, but in simple, everyday things.
words.example_cn: 幸福不在于奢华,而在于简单的日常小事。

words.example_en: Even when he was very ill, Morrie was never filled with despair.
words.example_cn: 即使病得很重,莫里也从未陷入绝望。

words.example_en: At first the old man's calm words sounded a little absurd to me.
words.example_cn: 起初,这位老人平静的话在我听来有点荒唐。

words.example_en: Morrie believed that an ordinary home is crammed with small happinesses.
words.example_cn: 莫里相信,一个普通的家里挤满了细小的幸福。

words.example_en: The Happiness of Pure Air was so light that it seemed transparent.
words.example_cn: 纯净空气之幸福如此轻盈,仿佛是透明的。

words.meaning_cn: 鼓舞人心的;给人启发的
words.example_en: Morrie's bravery near the end of his life was truly inspirational.
words.example_cn: 莫里生命尽头的勇敢确实鼓舞人心。

words.example_en: His quiet bravery moved everyone who read the book.
words.example_cn: 他那份平静的勇敢打动了每一个读这本书的人。

words.example_en: Morrie's reflections on love and friendship made me think deeply.
words.example_cn: 莫里对爱与友谊的沉思让我陷入深思。

words.example_en: Morrie's favourite poet wrote, "Love each other or perish."
words.example_cn: 莫里最爱的诗人写道:“彼此相爱,否则消亡。”

words.example_en: While we are living, we are easily distracted by small worries.
words.example_cn: 活着的时候,我们很容易被琐碎的烦恼分散注意力。

words.example_en: He warned young people against chasing only material things.
words.example_cn: 他告诫年轻人不要只追求物质的东西。

words.example_en: My first impression of the book turned out to be quite wrong.
words.example_cn: 我对这本书的最初印象后来证明大错特错。

words.example_en: You should not let any society determine your values for you.
words.example_cn: 你不该让任何社会替你决定自己的价值观。

words.example_en: Morrie taught us to value our own lives a little more.
words.example_cn: 莫里教会我们更珍视自己的生命。

words.example_en: He said no society should choose what really matters for you.
words.example_cn: 他说,没有哪个社会该替你选择什么才是真正重要的。

words.example_en: After finishing it, I felt I had a deeper insight into life.
words.example_cn: 读完之后,我觉得自己对人生有了更深的洞察。

words.example_en: Although it isn't my favourite book, I would still recommend it.
words.example_cn: 虽然它不是我最喜欢的书,我仍然会推荐它。

words.example_en: At first it seemed like a set of over-emotional thoughts.
words.example_cn: 起初它看起来像是一堆过于煽情的想法。

words.example_en: The book made me see how much I am influenced by popular culture.
words.example_cn: 这本书让我看清自己受流行文化影响有多深。

words.example_en: Real values are built on love and open communication.
words.example_cn: 真正的价值观建立在爱与坦诚的沟通之上。

words.example_en: His gentle words about friendship touched me the most.
words.example_cn: 他关于友谊的温柔话语最打动我。

words.example_en: From his window, Morrie observed every change of season.
words.example_cn: 莫里从窗口观察着每一次季节的变化。

words.example_en: The book encourages us to appreciate what we already have.
words.example_cn: 这本书鼓励我们珍惜已经拥有的东西。

words.example_en: Storytelling has long been a way to pass on wisdom.
words.example_cn: 讲故事长久以来都是传递智慧的一种方式。

words.example_en: A wise mentor walks with us on the journey of life.
words.example_cn: 一位智慧的引路人会陪我们走过人生的旅程。

words.example_en: Each fable ends with a short moral that teaches a lesson.
words.example_cn: 每则寓言都以一句简短的寓意作结,告诉人们一个道理。

words.example_en: Aesop's Fables teach important truths through animal stories.
words.example_cn: 《伊索寓言》通过动物故事讲述重要的道理。

words.example_en: History credits these famous fables to a Greek storyteller.
words.example_cn: 历史把这些著名的寓言归功于一位希腊讲故事的人。

words.example_en: Aesop used animals to reflect common human traits.
words.example_cn: 伊索用动物来映照人类共有的特点。

words.example_en: He summarised each life lesson in just one simple sentence.
words.example_cn: 他用简单的一句话概括了每一条人生道理。

words.example_en: Age was no barrier to the grandmother who returned to study.
words.example_cn: 对重返校园的老奶奶来说,年龄不是障碍。

words.example_en: After years of effort, she finally graduated from university.
words.example_cn: 经过多年努力,她终于从大学毕业了。
